title: editcap: add --sctp-split option to unbundle SCTP DATA chunks
description:
Split SCTP packets containing multiple bundled DATA chunks into
  individual packets, one per DATA chunk. Each output packet retains
  the original Ethernet, IP, and SCTP common headers with corrected
  IP total length. Non-SCTP packets and SCTP packets without DATA
  chunks pass through unchanged.

  A packet comment "Original frame: N" is added to each split packet
  to indicate which capture frame it originated from.

  Currently supports IPv4 over Ethernet (including 802.1Q VLAN).

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
